component.name: Animal Crossing AP
component.summary: Animal Crossing PC port with Archipelago

description.p: PC port of the Animal Crossing (GameCube) decompilation with an Archipelago multiworld client. Needs your own disc image: put it in ~/.var/app/io.github.haloopdy.AnimalCrossingAP/data/rom. Saves, settings and ap_config.ini are in that data folder too.
